correctness.rationale: The active dyadic-row Gram is D_b T_(1/sqrt2) D_b. Its inverse is an explicit positive half-line Jacobi matrix; two-site Floquet fibers give the essential bands, and the only boundary eigenvalue solves (u²λ)(u²λ−2−u²/v²)=0 with decay ratio −u²/v². Thus the sole gap eigen occurs exactly for u<v. Polar decomposition, monotone functional calculus and explicit infinite kernel complete the singular spectrum. A standalone Python checker passed 3768 supplementary examples and rational recurrences, which are not used in lieu of proof.
